page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2ne.6xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated physical cores on an x86_64 architecture, utilizing the Intel Xeon E5-2682v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 96.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced 4.0 GB of memory per core. It does not include any local storage or GPU accelerators, relying instead on network-attached storage options. Network connectivity is supported by a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear distinction between single-core and multi-core performance. Single-core processing is relatively weak, as evidenced by bottom 25% results in stress-ng and Geekbench single-core tests, alongside a poor rating in single-threaded gzip compression. However, the 24 dedicated physical cores deliver average multi-core performance across stress-ng, Passmark, and Geekbench multi-threaded suites. Memory bandwidth is consistently average, with read-only large block speeds reaching 90.83 GB/sec and write speeds at 53.0 GB/sec.

The instance demonstrates average performance in database operations, Redis SET operations (16.93 million operations per second), and static web serving throughput (10.83 GB/sec). Software compilation and image processing also fall within the average tier. Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced resource density, this instance is qualitatively cost-efficient for multi-threaded workloads that do not require high single-core clock speeds or local SSD storage. Appropriate workloads include general-purpose web serving, multi-threaded database operations, software compilation, and moderate-scale text or image processing.
